name: Bucket Protocol BUCK
oneLiner: BUCK is Bucket Protocol's overcollateralized Sui-native dollar stablecoin minted from SUI, BTC, ETH, and LSTs through CDP vaults with PSM stablecoin swaps.
collateral: SUI, BTC, ETH, and LSTs via CDPs; USDC/USDT via Peg Stability Module
pegMechanism: Overcollateralized CDPs with per-asset minimum collateral ratios (e.g. 110% for SUI); hard peg via direct BUCK redemption for collateral with dynamic redemption fee; soft peg via PSM enabling 1:1 swaps with USDC/USDT; liquidations via Tank module

oracleRisk.summary: Bucket v1 has 40 registered Sui collateral branches. Thirty-eight have currently refreshable threshold-one Supra or whitelisted derivative-rule SingleOracles that fail closed after ten seconds; two debt-bearing StakedHouse branches remain registered but their stale, unconfigured oracles make price-dependent actions unavailable.

branchApplicability.reviewer: Codex Safety Score V9 ORCL curation
branchApplicability.rationale: At finalized Sui checkpoint 298434520, Bucket protocol 0x9e3dab13212b27f5434416939db5dec6a319d15b89a84fd074d03ece6350d3df returned 40 registered Buckets. Every row had a positive mint ceiling plus matching Tank and SingleOracle. Thirty-eight had a configured collector or whitelisted-rule update path. The two StakedHouse rows retained debt and positive ceilings but had stale, unconfigured oracles, so price-dependent borrowing and liquidation were unavailable. Twenty-seven rows carried more than 1,000 raw debt units and thirteen were zero or dust; all 40 remain explicit because registration, debt, or residual resolution state persists.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Re-reviewed 2026-08-08 using Sui checkpoints 304909276-304911372. BUCK remains an unregulated Sui currency with no RegulatedCoinMetadata, DenyCapV2, legacy DenyCap, holder blacklist, or token-transfer pause. Bucket's official terms describe interface-level restrictions rather than an on-chain power over holder coins. The Peg Stability Module holds Circle USDC and Tether USDT for direct BUCK conversions; those issuers can freeze PSM-held balances and impair redemption liquidity, but cannot restrict transfers of already-held BUCK coin objects. Direct holder freeze is therefore false, with the PSM exposure recorded separately as upstream risk.

mintAuthority.summary: BUCK is minted through Bucket Protocol CDP/PSM functions on Sui. The BUCK TreasuryCap is locked inside the shared BucketProtocol object. Admin caps are held by EOA 0x169451… and the package UpgradeCap (policy=0, v27) by EOA 0x938884…, both confirmed Bucket Protocol team operational wallets.

controls.label: BucketProtocol shared object holding BUCK TreasuryCap
controls.capDescription: BUCK TreasuryCap is wrapped inside the shared BucketProtocol object; the object itself cannot raise a mint bound. A separately held AdminCap can call update_max_mint_amount, and the package UpgradeCap can change the mint-critical code.
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298999088, the shared BucketProtocol object was version 944302979 and held TreasuryCap 0x058715d59eda37c2a1880a3c0972878f4448f48f2ffe8ee43cff7ace6afabcd4 with total_supply 25967024785770812. The normalized buck module keeps the TreasuryCap in that object; its update_max_mint_amount entry requires a separate &AdminCap, so this shared mint path cannot itself raise the bound.

controls.label: Bucket admin cap owner (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298999088, 0x169451... had no object code and owned Bucket AdminCap 0xfa5775562f1df8b70ac72e07138d74c93f0398bf54803283f6beb75781d44979 and BktAdminCap 0x99a8a71bbf8b533b2aae8dd6b7e0d0b0c7995b2b58db343671b36e294a6f0af1. The normalized buck module requires &AdminCap for update_max_mint_amount, establishing this EOA as the cap-raising authority.

controls.label: Bucket package upgrade-cap owner (EOA)
controls.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298999088, 0x938884... had no object code and owned BUCK UpgradeCap 0x332cc625c24f8d95a2a8455248aa33fa669bdeeb2e83d7ade6e31a8814d0ec85 for current package 0x346684e428a8b24c43cb2af269176fdbc41760ea2aed3e2a9d5c09a3347198bb. Its policy is 0 and version is 27, which permits unrestricted package upgrades and therefore mint-logic changes.

review.evidence: At Sui checkpoint 298999088, shared BucketProtocol object 0x9e3dab... held the BUCK TreasuryCap. A distinct EOA 0x169451... owned the bucket AdminCap required by update_max_mint_amount, while EOA 0x938884... owned the policy-0, version-27 UpgradeCap for the current package. The TreasuryCap itself remains inaccessible outside the shared protocol object; the separate AdminCap and unrestricted UpgradeCap resolve the cap and code-change paths.

reserveReview.rationale: BUCK is issued through dynamic Bucket V1 collateral positions and Peg Stability Module exchanges. The pinned V1 interface exposes per-asset collateral vaults and CDP borrow, repay, redemption, and liquidation functions; the current branch review identifies 40 registered collateral branches at Sui checkpoint 298434520. At Sui checkpoint 298655668, the shared BucketProtocol object still held the BUCK TreasuryCap with raw total supply 25967024785770812. Neither issuer documentation, legal terms, archived PSM documentation, nor public Sui state publishes a current USD-value cross-basket allocation. The previous five static percentage rows are therefore not defensible.
